# Tokyo Night Day

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-tokyo-night-day)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-tokyo-night-day)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-tokyo-night-day)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-tokyo-night-day)

Tokyo Night Day is a **light** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the Tokyo Night family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-tokyo-night-day codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `tokyoNightDay` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { tokyoNightDay } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-tokyo-night-day';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, tokyoNightDay],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `tokyoNightDay` | `Extension` |
| `tokyoNightDayMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#e1e2e7` |
| Active line | `#d8d9e3` |
| Selection | `#c4cae4` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#015c7c` | bold | 5.75:1 | 5.30:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#015c7c` | bold | 5.75:1 | 5.30:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#6c39af` | - | 5.71:1 | 5.26:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#4d5379` | - | 5.74:1 | 5.29:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#1f44a1` | - | 6.76:1 | 6.23:1 | 5.38:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#0d53ac` | - | 5.70:1 | 5.25:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#015c7c` | - | 5.75:1 | 5.30:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#0d53ac` | - | 5.70:1 | 5.25:1 | 4.53:1 |

| Namespace | `namespace` | `#6c39af` | italic | 5.71:1 | 5.26:1 | 4.54:1 |
| String | `string` | `#425e22` | - | 5.68:1 | 5.24:1 | 4.52:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#1f44a1` | background, active line, selection | 5.38:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#4d5379` | gutter | 5.12:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#1f44a1` | background, active line | 6.23:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#015c7c` | background | 5.75:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #015c7c` | background, active line | 5.30:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#015c7c, 1px solid #015c7c` | background (fill or outline) | 5.75:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#99a7df66` | active line | 1.16:1 | Pass |
